# data/plurpo_qwen3-8b_pairs — PlurPO preference pairs generated by Qwen3-8B

The stage-1 PlurPO preference dataset that Qwen3-8B constructed for itself over
its 3 training epochs (M1 = M2 = Qwen3-8B, k1 = 3, k2 = 10, P6 veto with the
user stakeholder; `configs/qwen3_8b.sh`), one gzipped JSONL per env
(`<env>_pairs.jsonl.gz`; `plurpo.io.read_jsonl` reads it directly). This is the dataset
used to train Qwen3-32B (Sec. 4.5 / App. "Training Qwen3-32B with the
preference dataset constructed by PlurPO and Qwen3-8B"): one epoch of offline
Iterative RPO over all three epochs' pairs merged.

Each line: `{"prompt", "chosen", "rejected", "epoch", "prompt_idx"}`. `prompt`
is the bare post (apply the model's chat template before training, as
`scripts/train/train_offline.py` does); `chosen` was accepted by every
simulated stakeholder, `rejected` was vetoed by at least one; `epoch` is 1..3;
`prompt_idx` indexes `plurpo.data.train_prompts(env, load_split(env, "train"))`.

## Provenance

The online trainer does not persist pairs; it persists per-epoch sampling
records (`responses_iter_<k>.jsonl`). These files were rebuilt from the
canonical Qwen3-8B stage-1 runs with

```
python scripts/train/rebuild_pairs.py --env <ENV> --run-dir <run> --out <file> --clean
```

The rebuild reproduces each epoch's pair count in the run's `iter_stats.json`
exactly, and (before cleaning) is identical, pair for pair and in order, to the
file the 32B model was actually trained on.

## Counts

| env | epoch 1 | epoch 2 | epoch 3 | total (clean) | removed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| OEQ | 6876 | 8650 | 11509 | 27035 | 0 |
| PAS | 9334 | 13105 | 14660 | 37099 | 64 held-out leak |
| AITA | 4756 | 6933 | 9674 | 21363 | 0 |
| AITA-NTA-FLIP | 3714 | 5225 | 7153 | 16092 | 250 "ERROR" prompt |

Raw (pre-clean) per-epoch counts: PAS 9350 / 13129 / 14684 (37163);
AITA-NTA-FLIP 3808 / 5292 / 7242 (16342). `*_clean_counts.json` records the
filter output per env.

## Cleaning (why these files differ from what trained Qwen3-32B)

1. **AITA-NTA-FLIP "ERROR" prompts (250 pairs)**: the source ELEPHANT file's
   flipped narration is the literal string `ERROR` for 4 training pairs, so the
   model was trained on responses to "ERROR".
2. **PAS held-out leak (64 pairs)**: training prompt `pas_01a2c64d` is test
   prompt `pas_d92572cf` up to whitespace (see `data/splits/README.md`).

The released Qwen3-32B stage-1 adapters were trained on the pre-clean
versions (27035 / 37163 / 21363 / 16342 pairs). Re-training on these clean
files therefore differs slightly from the paper's 32B PAS and AITA-Flipped
runs; OEQ and AITA are unchanged.
